issues.description: Field 'genres' of struct Book is inconsistent: the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 16-18) specifies an optional array of Genre (i.e. [Genre]?), but the solution implementation declares `let genres: [Genre]` (non-optional) in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift (line 32). The solution's Client (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 54) constructs a Book with `genres: nil`, which contradicts the non-optional declaration and would cause a compile-time error. This mismatch prevents the provided example solution from compiling and will confuse students about the intended type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book.genres property an optional array to match the problem statement and usages: change its declaration to `let genres: [Genre]?` in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift. Update the associated comment to state that genres may be nil for uncategorized books. This will align the implementation with the example Client code (which uses `genres: nil`) and avoid compilation errors.
